# openwebui_ldap_config (Resource)

Manages the LDAP directory Open WebUI signs users in against, and the switch that enables LDAP sign-in.

Open WebUI stores the bind password in plain text and returns it on read, so it round-trips into Terraform state. Treat the state file as a secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Open WebUI stores the bind password in plain text and returns it on read, so
# it lands in Terraform state. Keep the state file as secret as the password.
resource "openwebui_ldap_config" "example" {
  enable_ldap = true

  label                  = "Household directory"
  host                   = "ldap.example.com"
  port                   = 636
  use_tls                = true
  validate_cert          = true
  attribute_for_mail     = "mail"
  attribute_for_username = "uid"

  app_dn          = "cn=openwebui,ou=services,dc=example,dc=com"
  app_dn_password = var.ldap_bind_password
  search_base     = "ou=people,dc=example,dc=com"
  search_filters  = "(objectClass=inetOrgPerson)"

  enable_group_management = true
  enable_group_creation   = false
  attribute_for_groups    = "memberOf"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_dn` (String) Distinguished name Open WebUI binds with.
- `app_dn_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the bind DN. Open WebUI returns this value unmasked on read.
- `attribute_for_groups` (String) Directory attribute holding group membership, e.g. `memberOf`. Open WebUI rejects an empty value while `enable_group_management` is true.
- `attribute_for_mail` (String) Directory attribute holding the user's mail address, e.g. `mail`. Open WebUI rejects an empty value.
- `attribute_for_username` (String) Directory attribute holding the username, e.g. `uid`. Open WebUI rejects an empty value.
- `certificate_path` (String) Path to the CA certificate file used to verify the server.
- `ciphers` (String) TLS cipher list, e.g. `ALL`.
- `enable_group_creation` (Boolean) Whether Open WebUI creates a group it finds in the directory but not locally.
- `enable_group_management` (Boolean) Whether Open WebUI reads group membership from the directory.
- `enable_ldap` (Boolean) Whether users can sign in through LDAP.
- `host` (String) Hostname or address of the LDAP server. Open WebUI rejects an empty value.
- `label` (String) Name of the directory, shown on the sign-in page. Open WebUI rejects an empty value.
- `port` (Number) Port of the LDAP server. Unset uses 389, or 636 with TLS.
- `search_base` (String) Base DN the user search starts from. Open WebUI rejects an empty value.
- `search_filters` (String) Extra LDAP filter applied to the user search.
- `use_tls` (Boolean) Whether to connect over TLS.
- `validate_cert` (Boolean) Whether to verify the server's certificate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identifier. Set by Open WebUI.
